rule.name: Z60STACK-2.5-touch
rule.entry: Long when completed-bar Z60 < -2.5 and close > EMA200 > EMA400; Short is the exact mirror. Enter next-bar open.
rule.exit: SMA60 mean exit, 1.5% safety stop, or 20-hour timeout.
